# `ew import`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from bin/ew/api/cli.json and bin/ew/schemas/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

3 subcommand path(s). The synopsis lists the flags; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too.

## `ew import csv`

```text
ew import csv [--out <out>] [--content <content>] [--strict] [--lenient] [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--out` | yes | no |
| `--content` | yes | no |
| `--strict` | no | no |
| `--lenient` | no | no |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | written, with its findings |
| 1 | nothing written: `--strict` refused error findings, or the records do not make a project |
| 2 | usage, starter content, an unreadable table, an `--out` that holds something, write errors |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.import-csv-result/1`, schema [`ew.import-csv-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.import-csv-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.import-csv-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `documents` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The library documents the import embedded. |
| `mode` | [`ImportCsvMode`](#importcsvmode) | yes |  | The import mode: `strict` (the default) or `lenient`. |
| `out` | string | yes |  | The new project's directory, as given (`--out`). |
| `records` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The records the import made. |
| `report` | array of [`TableReportRow`](#tablereportrow) | yes |  | The import report, one entry per finding, in the report's order. |
| `tables` | array of string | yes |  | The table files read, by name, in name order. |
| `written` | boolean | yes |  | Whether the project was written (`false`: `--strict` refused the error findings). |

### ImportCsvMode

The mode of `ew import csv`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"strict"` | A row the dialect refuses is dropped with an error finding, and the project is not written. |
| `"lenient"` | Foreign colour codes are kept with a warning; the project is written with its findings. |

### TableReportRow

One finding of a table import.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes |  | The finding code (`EW-IMP-002`). |
| `file` | string or `null` | no |  | The table file, where the finding has one. |
| `line` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | The table line, where the finding has one. |
| `message` | string | yes |  | The message. |
| `severity` | [`ReportSeverity`](#reportseverity) | yes |  | The severity. |

### ReportSeverity

The severity of a `ReportRow`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"info"` | Info. |
| `"warning"` | Warning. |
| `"error"` | Error. |

## `ew import parts`

```text
ew import parts [--project <project>] [--json] [--map <map>] [--as-of <as-of>] [--company <company>]...
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--json` | no | no |
| `--map` | yes | no |
| `--as-of` | yes | no |
| `--company` | yes | yes |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | imported and saved |
| 2 | usage, open, I/O and every other error |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.import-parts-result/1`, schema [`ew.import-parts-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.import-parts-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.import-parts-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `created` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The project-local part copies created. |
| `report` | array of [`ReportRow`](#reportrow) | yes |  | The report of a mapped import, one entry per finding; empty for the golden dialect. |
| `rows` | [`RowCounts`](#rowcounts) or `null` | no |  | The row counts of a mapped import (`--map`); `null` for the golden dialect. |
| `skipped` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The parts skipped (the project already has their key). |
| `source` | string | yes |  | The table's name. |

### ReportRow

One finding of a mapped parts import.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes |  | The finding code (`EW-IMP-002`). |
| `line` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | The table line, where the finding has one. |
| `message` | string | yes |  | The message. |
| `severity` | [`ReportSeverity`](#reportseverity) | yes |  | The severity. |

### ReportSeverity

The severity of a `ReportRow`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"info"` | Info. |
| `"warning"` | Warning. |
| `"error"` | Error. |

### RowCounts

The row counts of a mapped parts import.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duplicate` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Duplicate rows. |
| `new` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | New parts. |
| `rejected` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Rejected rows. |
| `unchanged` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Unchanged parts. |
| `updated` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Updated parts. |

## `ew import qet`

```text
ew import qet [--content <content>] [--report <report>] [--report-out <report-out>] [--strict] [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--content` | yes | no |
| `--report` | yes | no |
| `--report-out` | yes | no |
| `--strict` | no | no |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | imported, even with findings |
| 1 | the model check failed, or `--strict` with lost connections or error findings |
| 2 | usage, open, I/O and every other error |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.import-qet-result/1`, schema [`ew.import-qet-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.import-qet-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.import-qet-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `counts` | [`QetCounts`](#qetcounts) | yes |  | The records imported. |
| `derived_pages` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | The pages in page order of the derived model; `null` when the model check failed. |
| `findings` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The findings of the migration report. |
| `lenient_findings` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The findings of the lenient checks run on the import. |
| `lost_connections` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The connections the import could not keep. |
| `model_check_error` | string or `null` | no |  | Why the model check failed; `null` when it passed (exit 1 otherwise). |
| `report_out` | string or `null` | no |  | The file the migration report was written to (`--report-out`); `null` without one. |
| `source` | string | yes |  | The imported file's name (never its path). |

### QetCounts

The record counts of an `ImportQetResult`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `connections` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Connections. |
| `devices` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Devices (strips and terminals included). |
| `functions` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Functions. |
| `junctions` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Junctions. |
| `pages` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Pages. |
| `representations` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Representations. |
| `strips` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Terminal strips. |
| `terminals` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Terminals. |
